<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <!-- Phone layout switch. This page had NO viewport tag, so phones rendered
       it as a 980px desktop page shrunk to fit (tiny text, no phone CSS, iOS
       zooming into every field). Default is the phone's real width; on a
       phone the user can pick "Desktop" (a fixed 1280px layout, as before),
       saved in localStorage 'relay-view'. Runs before any CSS paints. -->
  <meta name="viewport" id="relayViewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
  <!-- Desktop mode on a phone is screen-aware (tablet-like), not a fixed tiny
